messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH ERROR RATE alert — /v1/embeddings 5xx spike in eu-west-1 (55% over last 5m). Suspected fallback activity. Tripped at 2026-03-15T10:12:47Z.

maria gonzalez: saw the pager. on it. opening thread, will coordinate with on-call.

ishaan patel: taking primary on-call. pinging dmitri for routing history.

dmitri kozlov: quick summary from logs: a pinned version for alias `embedder-prod` was recently changed (internal deploy earlier today). routing layer attempted fallback to a compatible variant but resolved to a chat/instruct runtime (v2-chat) instead of an embed-capable runtime -> schema mismatch -> 500s. This is a policy resolution error, not model inference code.

maria gonzalez: customer-impact check — CS dashboard shows ~7 customers with failing embed requests (retries + higher latency). roughly 4% of total embedding traffic hit errors; some saw 10–50% of their requests fail.

customer-success-joe: getting messages from two enterprise customers in EU complaining about embeddings returning 500s and "invalid response format". ticket numbers CU-8891, CU-8894. they're retrying and seeing degraded UX.

ishaan patel: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback alias to previous pinned version (safe) 2) add routing guard to block chat/instruct variants from resolving for embedding routes (quick config) 3) force-route live requests to dedicated embed pool (if available)

maria gonzalez: recommend do both 1 + 2 now. rollback first to stop current misroutes, add guard to prevent recurrence.

dmitri kozlov: I agree. the routing resolution path is currently permissive: the fallback policy allows 'closest architecture' which for alias mismatch can pick chat variant. we'll need a policy change but we can hotfix a deny-list for embedding endpoints.

ishaan patel: executing rollback of alias `embedder-prod` -> v1.3 (from v2-chat).

ops-bot: deploy control-plane: alias revert started by ishaan (action id act-7f9).

ishaan patel: rollback complete.

ops-bot: deploy control-plane: alias revert finished (act-7f9). propagation ~15s.

maria gonzalez: monitoring: 5xx rate dropping from 55% -> 18% in last 30s. still above baseline.

ishaan patel: applying temporary routing guard to prevent chat/instruct variants resolving for routes tagged `embeddings`. will push a policy with highest priority.

# policy snippet (pushed as emergency guard):

```
route: /v1/embeddings
priority: 1000
rule: deny_if(candidate_variant.type in ["chat","instruct"])\n```

ops-bot: routing policy update queued (policy-id pol-331).

ops-bot: routing policy update applied (pol-331).

maria gonzalez: error rate now 5xx -> 3.8% over last 1m. latency back to normal for most customers.

customer-success-joe: notifying impacted customers with status update and ETA for full resolution. sending patch notes to support.

ishaan patel: quick root-cause note: accidental alias flip during morning release window where a model version labeled 'v2' had both chat and embed variants; the alias automation picked the chat variant for that alias. Fallback policy then resolved to that chat variant when the embed runtime wasn't available. Need to tighten alias->variant binding invariants.

dmitri kozlov: evidence (excerpt from resolver logs):

```
{
  "req_id":"req-0xface",
  "route":"/v1/embeddings",
  "alias":"embedder-prod",
  "requested_type":"embedding",
  "resolved_variant":"v2-chat",
  "resolved_type":"chat",
  "error":"response_schema_mismatch"
}
```

maria gonzalez: for mitigation we also scaled the dedicated embed pool by +2 GPUs to drain backlog and reduce retries. ops reported no capacity issues now.

ops-bot: infra: scaled dedicated-embed-pool by 2 GPUs (scale-op s-442).

ishaan patel: quick manual check for other aliases with loose variant bindings. running a script now to list aliases where alias->variant type != alias expected type.

# check command (internal):

```
./scripts/check_alias_variant_types.sh --env prod | grep mismatched || true
```

ishaan patel: found 3 other aliases with ambiguous bindings (staging copies). creating follow-up ticket to enforce validation on alias updates.

maria gonzalez: CS impact summary for incident record: 7 customers affected, peak error rate 55% for embedding route in eu-west-1, estimated ~12k failed embedding requests over 20m window, ~2 high-priority support tickets escalated. recommending a customer-level credit for affected windows.

customer-success-joe: acknowledged, will prepare credit recommendations and outreach drafts.

dmitri kozlov: post-incident actions (short list):
- add schema/type validation in alias update path (prevent chat variant from being pinned to embed alias)
- make fallback policy stricter by default for content-type routes (embeddings/gen/chat)
- add alert that surfaces 'alias resolved to variant of different interface'
- add e2e test to catch alias flips in deploy pipeline

ishaan patel: created infra ticket INF-2024 "alias-binding validation and resolver alert" and assigned to routing team.

maria gonzalez: opened incident ticket INC-2026-0315, will draft timeline and customer impact.

ops-bot: pagerduty: incident acknowledged by ishaan (PD-4312).

ishaan patel: final status before handoff — 5xx rate stabilized to 0.9% in last 5m, customers have been notified, rollback + guard in place, dedicated pool scaled. moving to monitoring and RCA. handing off to dmitri for deep-dive.

dmitri kozlov: taking the handoff. I'll own RCA and postmortem, will loop in routing + release engineers.

maria gonzalez: thanks team. ishaan — please include timeline of when alias flip happened in your deploy notes.

ishaan patel: noted. timeline: alias flip at 2026-03-15T09:58:12Z during release batch #2102; detection at 10:12:47Z; rollback at 10:13:23Z; guard applied at 10:13:50Z; stabilize by 10:15:40Z.

customer-success-joe: I'll send follow-up to impacted customers with apology + mitigation summary.

maria gonzalez: leaving this thread open. tagging for postmortem: @dmitri @ishaan @routing-team @releases @cs.

ishaan patel: handing off on-call at 12:00 UTC to next engineer.

incident-bot: incident thread marked as "mitigated — monitoring".

maria gonzalez: postmortem owner dmitri. ETA draft by EOD tomorrow.

dmitri kozlov: acknowledged. I'll attach resolver logs and the guard patch to the postmortem.

maria gonzalez: closing immediate coordination. follow-ups in INF-2024 and INC-2026-0315. :white_check_mark:
